# After Mom or Dad

> Six practical books for adults in the United States in the first two years after a mother or father dies, by Edward Crowe (JMS Media Group LLC). In preparation: none is out yet. Each chapter will answer one question with a short answer first, then what to do, what can wait, and who can help. General information, not legal, financial, tax, medical or mental-health advice.

## The books

- [Book 1: The First Month](https://aftermomordad.com/books/the-first-month/): The first month. Who to call, what to find, what can wait.
- [Book 2: Being in Charge](https://aftermomordad.com/books/being-in-charge/): Months 1 to 9. Executor or administrator duties, with or without a will.
- [Book 3: Their Money](https://aftermomordad.com/books/their-money/): Months 1 to 12. Benefits, accounts, taxes, debts.
- [Book 4: Their House](https://aftermomordad.com/books/their-house/): Months 3 to 15. Stay or sell, and clearing a life.
- [Book 5: Siblings and the Estate](https://aftermomordad.com/books/siblings-and-the-estate/): Months 1 to 18. Family, fairness, and who gets what.
- [Book 6: Your Surviving Parent](https://aftermomordad.com/books/your-surviving-parent/): Months 3 to 24. When the other parent is now alone.

## Also

- [The First Two Weeks checklist](https://aftermomordad.com/start/): free, two pages, in preparation
- [If today is very bad](https://aftermomordad.com/help-tonight/): 988, the Veterans Crisis Line and the Crisis Text Line
- [About the books](https://aftermomordad.com/about/): how they are written and how facts are checked
- [The Widow’s Guide](https://widowsguide.org/): the same publisher's series for women after a husband dies
